verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents custom context files (GEMINI.md) specifically to tailor agent behavior per project, matching the story directly, but a hands-on report states the CLI 'consistently ignores my GEMINI.md file, both global and local' despite claiming to use it, contradicting reliable delivery. Missing for 10: independent confirmation the feature works reliably, more detail on syntax/precedence rules, and resolution of the ignoring-file complaint.
